## R workflow

The Semester 1 code-alongs build one reproducible workflow:

```r
#| eval: false

analysis_data <- patient_data |>
  select(...) |>
  filter(...) |>
  mutate(...)

analysis_data |>
  group_by(...) |>
  summarise(...)
```

The important habit is not memorising isolated functions. It is making every transformation answer a visible part of the clinical question.
